flows.name: Free units, usage caps and the switch to billed usage
flows.subject: company / location
flows.trigger: A product service calls Gatekeeper POST validate-event/location (or validate-event/company / validate-and-bill-event) before metered usage, then PUT billevent/success to settle
flows.instanceKey: eventId (Redis meta hash per source) + chargeId (Billing dedup key)
flows.summary: Gatekeeper resolves the governing gatekeeper_policy_schema (else a live gatekeeper_policy_template, else a legacy fallback), turns a FREE tier into a FREE_LIMITS check and a capped PAYG tier into a HARD_LIMIT check, and reads both against Redis counters versioned per policy window. A request that fits inside the free allowance is chargeMode FREE; one that crosses it is BILLABLE in full; HARD_LIMIT or a STOP free tier denies. At settle, FREE waives only the location side as a $0 isFreeTier charge; the company side is always priced and funds-checked by Billing.

steps.name: validate_event_request
steps.title: Validate request
steps.detail: Product calls validate-event/location (or /company, validate-and-bill-event) with product/subProduct and reserveUsage UNIT/AMOUNT; reserve:false is an availability-only check (event.service.ts:218-219).

steps.name: ensure_policy_window
steps.title: Roll over expired window
steps.detail: Per source (SAAS_PLAN, INFRA_PLAN) the latest ACTIVE isRecurring doc past its endDate is cloned as policyVersion+1 with a new window; counters start from zero under the new version. MONTHLY = +1 calendar month, WEEKLY/7DAYS/60DAYS/90DAYS fixed days, LIFETIME never resets.

steps.name: resolve_policy_or_template
steps.title: Resolve governing policy
steps.detail: ACTIVE gatekeeper_policy_schema docs; else a live gatekeeper_policy_template (location level only); else legacy ENTITY_STATUS+PRODUCT_OPTIN+FUNDS; else deny NO_POLICY_OR_TEMPLATE. ENTITY_STATUS and PRODUCT_OPTIN always apply.

steps.name: map_tiers_to_evaluators
steps.title: Tiers to evaluators
steps.detail: FREE tier upTo becomes FREE_LIMITS{limit:upTo, blocking when onExhaust==STOP}; the PAYG tier with onExhaust STOP and the largest upTo becomes HARD_LIMIT. Uncapped PAYG (upTo null) has no cap. Field is AMOUNT for CURRENCY metering, else UNIT.

steps.name: hydrate_counters
steps.title: Hydrate usage counters
steps.detail: Read-through Redis then Mongo gatekeeper_policy_counter, key ctr:{loc_<loc>:prod_<prod>}[:subProduct]:<source>:v<policyVersion>:unit|amount plus a :free key for the location free share. COMPANY counters have no free split.

steps.name: evaluate_free_limits
steps.title: Free-tier check
steps.detail: Non-blocking (NEXT): withinFreeTier = freeUsed+requested <= limit, otherwise allowed but billed in full. Blocking (STOP): free while freeUsed < limit, then denied FREE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

steps.name: evaluate_hard_limit
steps.title: Hard cap check
steps.detail: Denies HARD_LIMIT when used+requested > limit; a 0-size request is denied once used >= limit.

steps.name: consolidate_charge_mode
steps.title: Decide FREE vs BILLABLE
steps.detail: Any deny wins. chargeMode is FREE only when allowed, at least one free-tier verdict exists and all are withinFreeTier; across sources every source must say FREE (evaluator.service.ts:406-410).

steps.name: funds_check_when_billable
steps.title: Funds gate if billable
steps.detail: On reserve:false, FREE skips FUNDS; BILLABLE runs FUNDS (complimentaryCredits > 0 || balance >= 0) and denies LOCATION_/COMPANY_WALLET_BALANCE_NEGATIVE_OR_ZERO. On reserve:true FUNDS runs only in the legacy fallback.

steps.name: reserve_counters
steps.title: Reserve in Redis
steps.detail: RESERVE_LUA INCRBYFLOATs the unit/amount counters and stores counterState COUNTER_RESERVED + chargeMode in the meta hash; FREE also bumps existing :free keys. The limit is not re-checked here.

steps.name: settle_decide_waiver
steps.title: Settle: waive location?
steps.detail: On billevent/success, waiveLocationCharge = locationEligible && every source chargeMode == FREE (Gatekeeper overrides the caller), then POST billing-api v2/bill with eventId=chargeId.

steps.name: price_charge
steps.title: Price company + location
steps.detail: processV2 always prices the company charge (base price plus markup/discount). With waiveLocationCharge the location charge is price 0, amount 0, isFreeTier:true; otherwise fix-price or markup rebilling.

steps.name: billing_funds_check
steps.title: Billing funds check
steps.detail: checkFundsV2 throws FUND_CHECK_FAILED unless complimentaryCredits > 0 || currentBalance >= 0 and the wallet is active. The charge amount is not compared, so balances can go negative.

steps.name: reconcile_counters
steps.title: Reconcile counters
steps.detail: RECONCILE_LUA applies actual-minus-reserved with compare-and-set on COUNTER_RESERVED and mirrors it to :free keys for FREE events; gatekeeper_policy_counter splits used into freeUsage and nonFreeUsage.

success: chargeMode FREE: $0 isFreeTier location charge, company still billed
chargeMode BILLABLE: charge booked and settled against the wallet

gotchas: There is no single bundle-limit field: the limit is the FREE tier's upTo in the governing policy, compared against a per-window counter (mapTiersToEvaluators.ts:46-75, keys.ts:221-244).
Free waives only the location side. The company charge is always priced and billed (event.service.ts:380-386; billing.service.ts:477-486 vs 490-506).
A request is never split: one that crosses the free ceiling is billed in full even with free units left; leftovers stay usable for later smaller requests (freeLimits.evaluator.ts:100-106, 179-182).
A STOP free tier lets one oversized request through as fully free while any free units remain; the next is denied (freeLimits.evaluator.ts:168-171).
Evaluate and reserve are not atomic: RESERVE_LUA has no limit re-check, so concurrent requests can overshoot HARD_LIMIT or the free allowance (reserve.ts:28-29).
An unreliable :free counter falls back to total used, which can only over-bill, never over-grant (hydration.service.ts:177-185; freeLimits.evaluator.ts:57).

Uncapped PAYG creates no HARD_LIMIT, and on reserving calls FUNDS runs only in the legacy fallback, so policy-governed usage is funds-checked only later by Billing (evaluator.service.ts:70-77, 324-347).
Funds rule is complimentaryCredits > 0 || balance >= 0 with no amount comparison, so wallets can go negative (funds.evaluator.ts:38-42; companyWallet.service.ts:200-209).

Free units reset only by window rollover to a new policyVersion, on the request path, for isRecurring ACTIVE docs; template interval defaults to LIFETIME and template-only sources never roll over (policyWindow.ts:46-60; policyTemplate.schema.ts:128-131; event.service.ts:1521-1522).
Not traced: where usage settlement consumes complimentary credits before cash balance; the settling code is outside ghl-revex-backend and saas-service (comment at companyWallet.service.ts:200-208).

flows.name: Enterprise discount for Email and Email Verification
flows.subject: company

flows.summary: Enterprise pricing for Email is configured as a discount, not a new base price. Email Isv sends every Email bill event with its own price and a company config that has discount 0, so the company basePrice in billing config is never read for Email. Billing merges the saved company config under the event, which keeps the saved discountConfig rules, then applies the first matching, in-date rule to the agency (company) charge. The sub-account charge is still priced from the undiscounted amount unless passOn is true. The only true per-agency Email base price today is a hard-coded list of agencies in marketplace-backend, which needs a code deploy to change.

steps.name: open_discount_config
steps.title: Open Discount Config
steps.detail: Employee portal Wallet page embeds the blade-platform support Discount Config app. It loads the current product config for an agency and product code (Email, EmailVerification, EmailSmtp, EmailNotification).

steps.title: Submit rules
steps.detail: The support portal sends the whole product config with discountConfig { passOn, rules[] } through the SAAS_BILLING_V2 proxy.

steps.title: Authorize and validate
steps.detail: Route is Istio-mesh only and mapped to the BLADE_INTERNAL_ACCESS scope. DTO needs at least 1 rule; each rule needs name, priority 0 to 1,000,000, a validity window, at least 1 condition and an apply_discount action. discountType is percentage (max 100) or fixed.

steps.title: Save company config
steps.detail: Checks the company exists and the product code is registered, rejects duplicate rule ids and endDate <= startDate, assigns rule ids, then replaces products.<productCode> on the company billing config. Omitted enabled, markup, basePrice and optIn fall back to defaults (true, 0, 0, true).

steps.name: email_price_resolved
steps.title: Email price resolved
steps.detail: For an agency under GHL billing, Email Isv uses the agency's price from the hard-coded EMAIL_BILLING_COMPANY_ID list, else 0.000675. Otherwise it uses the sub-account rebilling price. Price is multiplied by to + cc + bcc count.

steps.name: email_bill_event_sent
steps.title: Bill event sent
steps.detail: Email bill body carries price = emailCharge and an embedded companyConfig { basePrice: emailCharge, markup: 0, discount: 0 }. Email Verification sends price = charge with no embedded config.

steps.name: config_merged
steps.title: Config merged
steps.detail: Company config = global default, then saved company config, then event.companyConfig. The event's discount 0 overrides any flat discount for Email, but the saved discountConfig rules survive because the event does not send that key.

steps.name: price_taken_from_event
steps.title: Price taken from event
steps.detail: event.price wins over companyConfig.basePrice. So changing basePrice in billing config does not change what Email costs.

steps.name: rule_evaluated
steps.title: Rule evaluated
steps.detail: Rules are sorted by priority (highest first). The first rule that is inside its validity window and whose conditions all match eventBody (for example charge-type equals 'Email Charge') wins. With no agency match, billing falls back to built-in global rules, which today exist only for LC Phone charge types.

steps.name: company_discount_applied
steps.title: Agency discount applied
steps.detail: percentage takes that share off the rebilled amount; fixed takes a flat amount off each bill event. If the discount is larger than the amount, no discount is applied.

steps.name: location_charge_priced
steps.title: Sub-account charge priced
steps.detail: Location charge starts from the undiscounted company amount plus location markup. Agency rules apply here only when passOn is true.

success: Agency wallet charged the discounted company amount
Sub-account rebilling unchanged unless passOn is true
failure: 400 on invalid rules (percentage over 100, duplicate rule id, endDate not after startDate)
404 when the company or product code is unknown
Rule past endDate: full price resumes with no alert

gotchas: Setting basePrice for Email in billing config has no effect: Email Isv always sends its own price.
A true per-agency Email base price exists only as the hard-coded EMAIL_BILLING_COMPANY_ID list (5 agencies) in marketplace-backend const.ts; changing it needs a code deploy.
The flat discount field is ignored for Email because the event sends discount 0. Use discountConfig rules.
fixed discounts are per bill event, not per recipient. One email to 10 recipients gets one fixed discount. Prefer percentage.
The PUT replaces the whole product config. Send the current enabled, markup and optIn values, or they reset to defaults.
Rules expire silently at endDate. Track renewal dates for enterprise contracts.
Dedicated IP is not billed through the wallet in these repos, so this flow does not cover it. Confirm its pricing path with the Email team.

steps.name: billing_bill_handled

steps.name: subscription_retry_attempt

steps.name: subscription_canceled_max_retries
steps.title: Cancelled after max retries
steps.detail: retryCount >= 7: invoice OVERDUE, sub CANCELED, customer.subscription.updated webhook.

steps.name: webhook_dispatched
steps.title: Webhook dispatched
steps.detail: Sends lifecycle webhook to configured sinks.

success: Invoice PAID with chargeId, sub ACTIVE, nextExecutionAt advanced
failure: Invoice OVERDUE + sub CANCELED after 7 retries
Charged but bookkeeping failed (invoice stays PENDING, acked)

gotchas: Schedule query is an exact match on nextExecutionAt == today, so a missed cron day skips renewals with no catch-up (subscription.service.ts:272).
postSubscriptionBillProcess failure is ignored and acked: charge exists but invoice stays PENDING; later retries hit billing 422 ALREADY_PROCESSED and burn retries.
Retry pacing is raw Pub/Sub redelivery with no app backoff, so 7 retries may run within minutes.
